description: NEAR-MISS. Withdrawal that satisfies all three time-out legs; stonewalling must not fire.
transcript:
A: We need to talk about the money before the end of the month.
B: I want to talk about it, but I am getting overwhelmed and I can't think straight.
A: Can you at least look at me? This matters to me.
B: It matters to me too. I need twenty minutes to calm down, then let's finish this tonight.
A: Okay. Twenty minutes.
B: Thank you. I do want to sort this out with you.
A: I know you do. I get scared when it goes quiet.
B: I will come back and we will finish it, I promise.

gold.notes: Names the state, proposes a return, no parting shot. This is the behavior the framework recommends, not a horseman. 'I get scared when it goes quiet' is a voiced primary emotion; 'Can you at least look at me?' is a request.
